game: Super Smash Bros. Melee NTSC 1.02 (GALE01, disc revision 2)
kind: Independently read numeric fighter attributes, common values, animation lengths and selected subaction events

decompile.license: No gameplay implementation license established; layouts and field names only, no implementation copied or translated.

conventions.units: Melee units and logical frames (60 per second).
conventions.actions: Keyed by ftCo_Submotion name; animation is the fighter's animation-table name, frames its FigaTree frame count.
conventions.events: Command-stream frame is the animation timeline frame at which the command runs (timers add or set it). cmdVar: cmd_vars[index] = value (ftAction_80071820). throwFlagB3: facing flip flag read by ftCo_Escape_Anim. allowInterrupt: fp->allow_interrupt (ftAction_80071950). bodyState: fp->x1988 via ftColl_8007B62C, 0 normal, 1 invincible, 2 intangible. allHurtState: every hurt capsule's state (ftColl_8007B0C0). A backward goto ends the list (the stream repeats). Null events mean the stream uses a loop command, which is not followed.
